title: Here Comes Treble
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this Halloween-themed episode, Dwight gets his head stuck inside a hollowed-out pumpkin, leading to comedic struggles and tension with Nellie over anxiety medication. Jim and Pam discuss and commit to a sports marketing business investment, while Andy introduces his Cornell a cappella group, Here Comes Treble, performing at the office party. The group faces internal drama when Broccoli Rob unexpectedly sings Andy's signature song, sparking a challenge for a sing-off. Meanwhile, various office dynamics unfold, including Angela's displeasure with the Halloween food arrangement and playful interactions between Nellie and Toby.
